attributes.name: align
attributes.summary: Stack alignment passed to setAlign; this is an engine-facing value, not text alignment.

attributes.name: alphaBlend
attributes.summary: Enable native widget background/border alpha blending where supported; useful for overlaying translucent rectangles.

attributes.name: alphaTest
attributes.summary: Pixmap transparency: off, on (alpha test), or blend (smooth alpha blending).

attributes.name: alphatest
attributes.summary: Compatibility spelling for alphaTest. Use the canonical camel-case name in new examples.

attributes.name: animationMode
attributes.summary: Control window show/hide animation; off disables both directions.

attributes.name: animationPaused
attributes.summary: Reserved no-op in this revision; it does not pause an animation.

attributes.name: backgroundColor
attributes.summary: Solid #AARRGGBB/named colour, or gradient specification start[,middle],end,direction[,alphaBlend].

attributes.name: backgroundColorEven
attributes.summary: Solid colour for alternating even list rows; gradients are not accepted here.

attributes.name: backgroundColorOdd
attributes.summary: Solid base/odd-row list background; gradients are not accepted here.

attributes.name: backgroundColorRows
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of backgroundColorEven.

attributes.name: backgroundColorSelected
attributes.summary: Selected row background, as solid colour or a gradient specification.

attributes.name: backgroundGradient
attributes.summary: Deprecated dedicated gradient attribute; use a gradient value in backgroundColor.

attributes.name: backgroundGradientSelected
attributes.summary: Deprecated dedicated selected-row gradient attribute; use backgroundColorSelected.

attributes.name: backgroundPixmap
attributes.summary: Background image for a native target implementing setBackgroundPixmap; not universal to all widgets.

attributes.name: base
attributes.summary: Reserved no-op in AttributeParser; do not expect a visible effect from this setter.

attributes.name: borderColor
attributes.summary: Generic border setter. On eLabel this currently changes the text outline; use widgetBorderColor for a rectangle border.

attributes.name: borderWidth
attributes.summary: Generic border width. On eLabel this currently changes glyph outlines; use widgetBorderWidth for the widget frame.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.summary: Construction-time condition evaluated by readSkin for supported config/BoxInfo expressions, not a live visibility binding.

attributes.name: conditional
attributes.summary: Include an element when at least one named component exists in the screen; processed by readSkin.

attributes.name: connection
attributes.summary: Names the component connections for a GUI addon; readSkin consumes this before attribute application.

attributes.name: cornerRadius
attributes.summary: Corner radius, optionally followed by a semicolon and edge names, e.g. 24;topLeft,topRight.

attributes.name: enableWrapAround
attributes.summary: Allow list navigation to wrap from the final entry to the first and back.

attributes.name: entryFont
attributes.summary: Font for configuration entry labels on native targets supporting it.

attributes.name: errorCorrection
attributes.summary: QR code recovery level: low, medium, quartile or high.

attributes.name: excludes
attributes.summary: Skip an element when any listed component exists; processed while building the screen.

attributes.name: flags
attributes.summary: Comma-separated eWindow flags, for example wfNoBorder; belongs on a screen/window.

attributes.name: font
attributes.summary: Registered font face or alias and size, for example Regular;28. It is not a font file path.

attributes.name: fontScale
attributes.summary: Automatic label font adjustment: size;offset or width;offset (default offset -4).

attributes.name: foregroundColor
attributes.summary: Text/foreground colour. A gradient value is supported only by the slider foreground path.

attributes.name: foregroundColorSelected
attributes.summary: Foreground/text colour for selected list entries.

attributes.name: foregroundGradient
attributes.summary: Legacy dedicated slider-gradient attribute; prefer a gradient in foregroundColor.

attributes.name: gradientMode
attributes.summary: Slider gradient behaviour: legacy or explicit. Check the receiver version before using this newer option.

attributes.name: hAlign
attributes.summary: Compatibility spelling for horizontalAlignment.

attributes.name: halign
attributes.summary: Legacy spelling for horizontalAlignment.

attributes.name: headerFont
attributes.summary: Font for configuration/list headers on supporting targets.

attributes.name: headerForegroundColor
attributes.summary: Foreground colour of configuration/list headers.

attributes.name: horizontalAlignment
attributes.summary: Text alignment inside its rectangle: left, center, right or block.

attributes.name: ignoreWidgets
attributes.summary: Screen metadata for optional widgets; the AttributeParser handler itself is a no-op.

attributes.name: includes
attributes.summary: Include an element when any listed component exists; the counterpart of excludes.

attributes.name: itemAlignment
attributes.summary: Align list items within the available list rectangle; distinct from text alignment.

attributes.name: itemCornerRadius
attributes.summary: Rounded item background in its normal state.

attributes.name: itemCornerRadiusMarked
attributes.summary: Rounded background for a marked item.

attributes.name: itemCornerRadiusMarkedAndSelected
attributes.summary: Rounded background when the item is both marked and selected.

attributes.name: itemCornerRadiusSelected
attributes.summary: Rounded background of the selected item.

attributes.name: itemGradient
attributes.summary: Background gradient for a normal list item.

attributes.name: itemGradientMarked
attributes.summary: Background gradient for a marked item.

attributes.name: itemGradientMarkedAndSelected
attributes.summary: Background gradient for an item that is both marked and selected.

attributes.name: itemGradientSelected
attributes.summary: Background gradient for the selected list item.

attributes.name: itemHeight
attributes.summary: Height of one list entry, scaled vertically.

attributes.name: itemSpacing
attributes.summary: Horizontal and vertical gap between list items; one value applies to both axes.

attributes.name: itemWidth
attributes.summary: Width of one list item, scaled horizontally.

attributes.name: label
attributes.summary: Reserved metadata/no-op in AttributeParser; no label is created by this attribute alone.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.summary: Select panel/stack layout in the structure parser; this setter itself is a no-op.

attributes.name: listOrientation
attributes.summary: List layout: vertical, horizontal or grid; not a slider direction.

attributes.name: noWrap
attributes.summary: Legacy wrap alias; prefer wrap="noWrap" or wrap="wrap".

attributes.name: objectTypes
attributes.summary: Construction-time component type check: componentName,ClassName[,ClassName].

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.summary: Slider direction: orHorizontal/orLeftToRight, orRightToLeft, orVertical/orTopToBottom, orBottomToTop.

attributes.name: OverScan
attributes.summary: Legacy spelling for overScan.

attributes.name: overScan
attributes.summary: Pass the overscan value to a native target implementing setOverscan; this is not global TV calibration.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.summary: One, two or four comma-separated inset values: left,top,right,bottom. Two values repeat as x,y,x,y.

attributes.name: pixmap
attributes.summary: Resolved image path passed to LoadPixmap; PNG transparency is commonly used.

attributes.name: pointer
attributes.summary: Pointer image and anchor offset for supporting widgets; see the source setter for the colon-separated path/coordinate syntax.

attributes.name: position
attributes.summary: x,y relative to the current layout context; centre and arithmetic coordinates are supported.

attributes.name: quietZone
attributes.summary: QR code quiet-zone size; does not add general-purpose label padding.

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.summary: The design coordinate system width,height; readSkin derives scaling from the desktop.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.summary: Pixmap scaling flags, for example none, scale, keepAspect or centerScaled. Not screen resolution scaling.

attributes.name: scaleFlags
attributes.summary: Temporary compatibility route to the pixmap scale flag parser; prefer scale.

attributes.name: scrollbarBackgroundColor
attributes.summary: Solid colour behind the scrollbar handle.

attributes.name: scrollbarBackgroundGradient
attributes.summary: Gradient behind the scrollbar handle on supporting targets.

attributes.name: scrollbarBackgroundPicture
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarBackgroundPixmap.

attributes.name: scrollbarBackgroundPixmap
attributes.summary: Image behind the scrollbar handle.

attributes.name: scrollbarbackgroundPixmap
attributes.summary: Legacy spelling of scrollbarBackgroundPixmap.

attributes.name: scrollbarBorderColor
attributes.summary: Scrollbar border colour.

attributes.name: scrollbarBorderWidth
attributes.summary: Scrollbar border thickness, scaled horizontally.

attributes.name: scrollbarForegroundColor
attributes.summary: Scrollbar handle colour.

attributes.name: scrollbarForegroundGradient
attributes.summary: Scrollbar handle gradient.

attributes.name: scrollbarForegroundPixmap
attributes.summary: Scrollbar handle image.

attributes.name: scrollbarLength
attributes.summary: Scrollbar length: numeric value, full or auto; interpretation is the target widget's.

attributes.name: scrollbarMode
attributes.summary: Visibility and side of the scrollbar; showOnDemand, showAlways, showNever and side-specific modes.

attributes.name: scrollbarOffset
attributes.summary: Integer distance/offset passed to the native scrollbar; this handler does not apply screen scaling.

attributes.name: scrollbarRadius
attributes.summary: Rounded scrollbar corners, optionally restricted to named edges.

attributes.name: scrollbarScroll
attributes.summary: Scrollbar movement granularity: byPage or byLine.

attributes.name: scrollbarSliderBorderColor
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarBorderColor.

attributes.name: scrollbarSliderBorderWidth
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarBorderWidth.

attributes.name: scrollbarSliderForegroundColor
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarForegroundColor.

attributes.name: scrollbarSliderPicture
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarForegroundPixmap.

attributes.name: scrollbarSliderPixmap
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarForegroundPixmap.

attributes.name: scrollbarWidth
attributes.summary: Scrollbar thickness, scaled horizontally.

attributes.name: scrollText
attributes.summary: Scrolling text configuration as comma-separated key=value pairs; direction, delays, repeat, stepSize and mode.

attributes.name: secondFont
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of valueFont for supporting configuration/list targets.

attributes.name: secondfont
attributes.summary: Legacy spelling delegating to valueFont; use valueFont in new layouts.

attributes.name: seek_pointer
attributes.summary: Legacy spelling of seekPointer.

attributes.name: seekPointer
attributes.summary: Secondary seek pointer image and anchor offset, for widgets that support it.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.summary: Enable or disable drawing the list selection highlight.

attributes.name: selectionDisabled
attributes.summary: Legacy inverted selection switch; prefer selection="0" to disable highlighting.

attributes.name: selectionPixmap
attributes.summary: Image used for the list selection background.

attributes.name: selectionZoom
attributes.summary: Selection enlargement as an integer percentage increment[,mode]: 25 means 1.25 times the normal size. The increment is capped at 500; see parseZoom for the mode.

attributes.name: selectionZoomSize
attributes.summary: Explicit enlarged selection width,height[,mode].

attributes.name: separatorLineColor
attributes.summary: Colour of entry separators in supporting lists.

attributes.name: separatorLineSize
attributes.summary: Separator geometry: height, top,height or left,top,width,height; -1 has automatic/full-width meaning.

attributes.name: shadowColor
attributes.summary: Colour of the label text shadow.

attributes.name: shadowOffset
attributes.summary: x,y offset of the text shadow; scaled with the screen.

attributes.name: size
attributes.summary: width,height of the widget; does not set its text alignment or font size.

attributes.name: sliderPixmap
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of scrollbarForegroundPixmap; this is not the progress-bar foreground.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.summary: Spacing setter for supporting native widgets; a panel also consumes spacing for its layout context.

attributes.name: spacingColor
attributes.summary: Colour of spacing in a native widget that supports setSpacingColor.

attributes.name: stack
attributes.summary: Reserved structural metadata; the AttributeParser handler itself performs no action.

attributes.name: tabWidth
attributes.summary: Tab-stop width for supporting text widgets; auto uses the automatic width.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.summary: Integer widget identifier used by native stack/layout machinery.

attributes.name: text
attributes.summary: Static text, translated before setText. Python or a renderer may replace it later.

attributes.name: textBorderColor
attributes.summary: Explicit colour of the outline around glyphs; different from a rectangle border.

attributes.name: textBorderWidth
attributes.summary: Explicit glyph-outline thickness, scaled vertically.

attributes.name: textOffset
attributes.summary: Deprecated route to padding via textPadding; prefer padding.

attributes.name: textPadding
attributes.summary: Deprecated alias of padding.

attributes.name: title
attributes.summary: Window title; translated with the current interface locale before being applied.

attributes.name: transparent
attributes.summary: Boolean: suppress the widget background. This is distinct from the transparency byte in a painted colour.

attributes.name: underline
attributes.summary: Enable or disable underlined label text.

attributes.name: vAlign
attributes.summary: Compatibility spelling for verticalAlignment.

attributes.name: valign
attributes.summary: Legacy spelling for verticalAlignment.

attributes.name: valueFont
attributes.summary: Font for configuration values on supporting targets.

attributes.name: verticalAlignment
attributes.summary: Text alignment inside the widget: top, center/middle or bottom.

attributes.name: widgetBorderColor
attributes.summary: Explicit rectangular widget-frame colour, including on eLabel.

attributes.name: widgetBorderWidth
attributes.summary: Explicit rectangular widget-frame thickness, scaled vertically.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.summary: Text overflow mode: wrap, noWrap or ellipsis; current parser also accepts numeric strings.

attributes.name: zPosition
attributes.summary: Integer painting layer among overlapping widgets; larger values are in front.

functions.name: InitSkins
functions.summary: Load emergency, subtitle, primary, display, optional skin parts and user overrides; configure desktop resolution and templates. Startup operation, not a per-widget helper.

functions.name: loadSkin
functions.summary: Read one XML skin and register its global resources and named screens. Returns True on a readable parsed skin, False otherwise; does not open a screen.

functions.name: reloadSkins
functions.summary: Reload global skin state and window styles. This is a broad application operation, not needed for opening an isolated example.

functions.name: loadSkinTemplates
functions.summary: Load component XML template definitions from the supplied filenames.

functions.name: reloadSkinTemplates
functions.summary: Rebuild component template definitions; clear=True resets previously registered definitions.

functions.name: addCallback
functions.summary: Register a callback to be notified when skin loading invokes its callback list.

functions.name: removeCallback
functions.summary: Remove a previously registered skin callback.

functions.name: getParentSize
functions.summary: Find a widget parent's size or use the desktop, for relative coordinate calculations.

functions.name: skinError
functions.summary: Write a skin error to the Enigma2 log; does not itself raise an exception.

functions.name: attribDeprecationWarning
functions.summary: Write a deprecated-attribute warning and its replacement to the log.

functions.name: parseOptions
functions.summary: Look up a string in an allowed-options dictionary; log and return the given default for an invalid value.

functions.name: parseValuePair
functions.summary: Parse a comma-separated x,y pair, with variables, axis-specific scaling and optional parent/widget dimensions. Returns a tuple.

functions.name: parseAlphaTest
functions.summary: Map off/on/blend to native pixmap alpha flags. Invalid input falls back to off.

functions.name: parseAnimationMode
functions.summary: Map window-animation strings to native show/hide flags.

functions.name: parseBoolean
functions.summary: Return True for 1, the supplied attribute name, enabled, on, true or yes (case-insensitive); other strings are False.

functions.name: parseColor
functions.summary: Resolve #AARRGGBB or a registered colour name to gRGB; invalid input logs and uses the specified fallback.

functions.name: parseCoordinate
functions.summary: Evaluate one design coordinate with scaling, center/c/e/percent and font-relative terms. Returns an integer, or None for the wildcard. It is not a CSS expression parser.

functions.name: parseErrorCorrection
functions.summary: Map QR recovery-level names to eQRCode constants; default medium.

functions.name: parseFont
functions.summary: Resolve face/alias and optional ;size to a gFont. Font size is scaled on the vertical axis; an unknown face falls back to Body.

functions.name: parseFontScale
functions.summary: Parse size;offset or width;offset into a scale mode and vertically scaled offset.

functions.name: parseGradient
functions.summary: Parse start[,middle],end,horizontal-or-vertical[,alphaBlend]; return three colours, direction and blending flag.

functions.name: parseHorizontalAlignment
functions.summary: Map left, center, right or block to native text alignment; invalid input defaults to left.

functions.name: parseInteger
functions.summary: Convert to int; log and return the supplied default on TypeError or ValueError.

functions.name: parseItemAlignment
functions.summary: Map item alignment names to native listbox alignment constants.

functions.name: parseListOrientation
functions.summary: Map vertical/horizontal/grid to listbox orientation bits; invalid input falls back to vertical.

functions.name: parseOrientation
functions.summary: Map slider direction names to orientation and reverse-direction flags.

functions.name: parseParameter
functions.doc: This function is responsible for parsing parameters in the skin, it can parse integers, floats, hex colors, hex integers, named colors, fonts and strings.
functions.summary: Convert a parameter token to string, colour integer, hex integer, float, named colour, font list or integer according to its prefix/content.

functions.name: parsePixmap
functions.summary: Load an existing resolved image path through LoadPixmap; strip a # suffix and log missing or unreadable files. Returns a pixmap or None.

functions.name: parsePosition
functions.summary: Parse an x,y pair and return an ePoint.

functions.name: parseRadius
functions.summary: Parse radius[;edge,edge] into a radius and corner bitmask. Plain radius applies to all corners.

functions.name: parseScrollbarLength
functions.summary: Parse a numeric length, full (0) or auto (-1), otherwise return the caller's default.

functions.name: parseSize
functions.summary: Parse a width,height pair and return an eSize.

functions.name: parseTabWidth
functions.summary: Parse a numeric tab width or auto (-1), otherwise return the caller's default.

functions.name: parseScale
functions.summary: Map pixmap scaling/alignment names to native blit flags; preserves numerous compatibility spellings.

functions.name: parseScrollbarMode
functions.summary: Map visibility/side names to native listbox scrollbar constants.

functions.name: parseScrollbarScroll
functions.summary: Map byPage/byLine to the native scrolling policy.

functions.name: parseScrollText
functions.summary: Parse comma-separated key=value text-scrolling options into direction, delays, repeat, step size and mode.

functions.name: parseSeparator
functions.doc:
left, top, width, height
top, height
height

width=-1 -> full width - margin ( default )
top=-1 -> center ( default )
functions.summary: Expand 1/2/4 separator values into left,top,width,height; supports automatic -1 fields.

functions.name: parsePadding
functions.summary: Expand 1/2/4 integers into left,top,right,bottom. Two values become x,y,x,y; it is not CSS top/right order.

functions.name: parseVerticalAlignment
functions.summary: Map top, center/middle or bottom to native text alignment; invalid input defaults to center.

functions.name: parseWrap
functions.summary: Map ellipsis/noWrap/wrap to 2/0/1; otherwise parse an integer with fallback 1.

functions.name: parseZoom
functions.summary: Map a list selection zoom mode to native listbox constants.

functions.name: collectAttributes
functions.signature: collectAttributes(skinAttributes, node, context, skinPath=None, ignore=(), filenames=frozenset(('pixmap', 'pointer', 'seekPointer', 'seek_pointer', 'backgroundPixmap', 'selectionPixmap', 'sliderPixmap', 'scrollbarBackgroundPixmap', 'scrollbarForegroundPixmap', 'scrollbarbackgroundPixmap', 'scrollbarBackgroundPicture', 'scrollbarSliderPicture')))
functions.summary: Resolve XML attributes, filenames, position, size, fonts and layout context before applying them to native objects. Mutates the supplied attribute list.

functions.name: applyAllAttributes
functions.summary: Construct an AttributeParser for a native object and apply the collected name/value pairs.

functions.name: loadSingleSkinData
functions.doc: Loads skin data like colors, windowstyle etc.
functions.summary: Process global skin data such as output, includes, colours, fonts, parameters, layouts, subtitle styles and window styles.

functions.name: reloadWindowStyles
functions.summary: Reapply stored window-style definitions.

functions.name: readSkin
functions.summary: Choose a named or embedded screen, build its layout contexts, connect sources/converters/renderers and collect component attributes. Called by Screen.

functions.name: findSkinScreen
functions.summary: Return the first registered name found in a name or list of names, otherwise None.

functions.name: findWidgets
functions.summary: Return names of widgets/sources/addon connections from a registered screen, expanding named panels; this is an XML scan, not screen execution.

functions.name: getcomponentTemplate
functions.summary: Return the registered XML component template for component/name (spelling is case-sensitive).

functions.name: getcomponentTemplateNames
functions.summary: Return names of registered component templates for a component.

functions.name: getScrollLabelStyle
functions.summary: Return one stored ScrollLabel default by key, or None if absent.

functions.name: getSkinFactor
functions.summary: Return desktop height divided by 720. Deprecated for OpenATV; prefer the screen resolution attribute for new layouts.

functions.name: applySkinFactor
functions.doc:
Multiply the numeric input by the skin factor
and return the result as an integer.
functions.summary: Legacy helper multiplying numeric arguments by getSkinFactor; returns an int for one argument or tuple for multiple arguments.

classes.name: AttributeParser
classes.summary: Dispatches collected XML attribute names to native GUI methods; it is a shared dispatcher, not a guarantee that every widget supports every attribute.

classes.name: additionalWidget
classes.summary: Internal holder for a decorative native widget and its skin attributes.

classes.name: ComponentTemplates
classes.summary: Stores and retrieves component XML templates and tracks changes.

classes.name: SizeTuple
classes.summary: Tuple adapter used for already-parsed coordinates while retaining string-like methods expected by skin code.

classes.name: SkinContext
classes.summary: Layout origin, available size, scale and font context; edge-docked children can consume available space.

classes.name: SkinContextStack
classes.summary: Layout context that places children without consuming the available parent rectangle.

classes.name: SkinContextVertical
classes.summary: Context for vertically arranged content and its remaining space.

classes.name: SkinContextHorizontal
classes.summary: Context for horizontally arranged content and its remaining space.

classes.name: TemplateParser

methods.name: collectAttributes
methods.signature: collectAttributes(self, node, context, ignore=(), excludeItemIndexes=None, includeItemIndexes=None)

classes.summary: Internal parser for list/content XML templates. Listed for discovery; full list-template tutorials belong to a later chapter.

classes.name: SkinError
classes.summary: Skin-processing exception type whose message can include the configured skin context.
